name: OnboardingChecklist
description: A checklist evaluating how quickly and frictionlessly a developer can go from API provider signup to first successful call.

provider.description: Name of the API provider being evaluated.

api_name.description: Specific API or product within the provider being evaluated.

category.description: Editorial category for the quick-win API.

self_serve_signup.description: Whether a developer can sign up without sales contact.

free_tier.description: Whether the provider offers a free tier or trial credits.

credit_card_required.description: Whether a credit card is required at signup.

time_to_first_call_minutes.description: Median observed time, in minutes, from account creation to first successful API call.

quickstart_url.description: URL to the provider's flagship quickstart tutorial.

documentation_url.description: URL to the provider's primary developer documentation.

openapi_available.description: Whether an official OpenAPI specification is published.

official_sdks.description: Programming languages with officially maintained SDKs.

postman_collection.description: Whether an official Postman collection is published.

interactive_playground.description: Whether the docs include an in-browser API playground.

sandbox_environment.description: Whether a dedicated sandbox is offered.

public_pricing.description: Whether per-unit pricing is published publicly.

editorial_score.description: Kin Lane's editorial 'quick win' score on a 0-10 scale.

notes.description: Editorial notes on why this API qualifies as low hanging fruit.
notes.example: Canonical first-integration example; sandbox keys appear in the dashboard immediately.
